mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; itraconazole may inhibit amikacin metabolism and increase its renal accumulation, while amikacin increases risk of itraconazole-related hepatotoxicity through renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and hearing regularly; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dosage adjustment based on renal function.
